meaning:
πεντήκοντα
indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά,
fifty: Luk.7:41 16:6, Jhn.8:57 21:11, Act.13:20; ἀνὰ π., Luk.9:14; κατὰ π., Mrk.6:40.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
“A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
